arxiv-1807-03847.title: Scalable Katz Ranking Computation in Large Static and Dynamic Graphs
arxiv-1807-03847.creator: Alexander van der Grinten, Elisabetta Bergamini, Oded Green, David A. Bader, Henning Meyerhenke
arxiv-1807-03847.description: Abstract Network analysis defines a number of centrality measures to identify the most central nodes in a network. Fast computation of those measures is a major challenge in algorithmic network analysis. Aside from closeness and betweenness, Katz centrality is one of the established centrality measures. In this paper, we consider the problem of computing rankings for Katz centrality.

arxiv-1809-09667.title: Composite Higgs Models with a Hidden Sector
arxiv-1809-09667.creator: Ann E. Nelson, Michael Park, Devin G. E. Walker
arxiv-1809-09667.description: Abstract We discuss the phenomenology of composite Higgs models that naturally produce a Standard Model-like Higgs boson with a mass of 126 126 GeV. The effective theory below the compositeness scale is weakly coupled in these models, and the goldstone sector acts as a portal between the third generation of quarks and a hidden gauge sector.

arxiv-1902-00598.title: Dynamic Equivalence of Control Systems and Infinite Permutation Matrices
arxiv-1902-00598.creator: Jeanne N. CLELLAND †, Yuhao HU † and Matthew W. STACKPOLE ‡
arxiv-1902-00598.description: Abstract To each dynamic equivalence of two control systems is associated an infinite permutation matrix. We investigate how such matrices are related to the existence of dynamic equivalences. keywords dynamic equivalence; control systems AMS 34H05; 58A15; 58A17 † † shorttitle: Dynamic Equivalence of Control Systems and Infinite Permutation Matrices † † runningauthor: J.N. arxiv-2109-02495.title: Gravitational Lensing By a Massive Object in a Dark Matter Halo. II. Shear, Phase, and Image Geometry
arxiv-2109-02495.creator: Michal Karamazov, David Heyrovský
arxiv-2109-02495.description: Abstract We study the gravitational lensing influence of a massive object in a dark matter halo, using a simple model of a point mass embedded in a spherical Navarro–Frenk–White halo. Building on the analysis of critical curves and caustics presented in the first part of this work, we proceed to explore the geometry of images formed by the lens.

arxiv-2409-14952.title: The Laurent-Horner method for validated evaluation of Chebyshev expansions
arxiv-2409-14952.creator: Jared L. Aurentz, Behnam Hashemi
arxiv-2409-14952.description: Abstract We develop a simple two-step algorithm for enclosing Chebyshev expansions whose cost is linear in terms of the polynomial degree. The algorithm first transforms the expansion from Chebyshev to the Laurent basis and then applies the interval Horner method.

arxiv-2410-02096.title: DomainDynamics: Lifecycle-Aware Risk Timeline Construction for Domain Names
arxiv-2410-02096.creator: Daiki Chiba, Hiroki Nakano, and Takashi Koide
arxiv-2410-02096.description: Abstract The persistent threat posed by malicious domain names in cyber-attacks underscores the urgent need for effective detection mechanisms. Traditional machine learning methods, while capable of identifying such domains, often suffer from high false positive and false negative rates due to their extensive reliance on historical data.

arxiv-2503-21977.title: Observation of \PW ​ \PZ ​ \PGg \PW\PZ\PGg production and constraints on new physics scenarios in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2503-21977.description: Abstract A measurement of the \PW ​ \PZ ​ \PGg \PW\PZ\PGg triboson production cross section is presented. The analysis is based on a data sample of proton-proton collisions at a center-of-mass energy of s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV recorded with the CMS detector at the LHC, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 138 \fbinv .

arxiv-2504-13672.title: Magnecko: Design and Control of a Quadrupedal Magnetic Climbing Robot
arxiv-2504-13672.creator: Stefan Leuthard, Timo Eugster, Nicolas Faesch, Riccardo Feingold, Connor Flynn, Michael Fritsche, Nicolas Hürlimann, Elena Morbach, Fabian Tischhauser, Matthias Müller, Markus Montenegro, Valerio Schelbert, Jia-Ruei Chiu, Philip Arm, Marco Hutter
arxiv-2504-13672.description: Abstract Climbing robots hold significant promise for applications such as industrial inspection and maintenance, particularly in hazardous or hard-to-reach environments. This paper describes the quadrupedal climbing robot Magnecko , developed with the major goal of providing a research platform for legged climbing locomotion.

arxiv-2506-08128.title: Network nonlocality with continuous variables: probing nonbilocality through pseudospin measurements
arxiv-2506-08128.creator: Sudip Chakrabarty, Amit Kundu, A. S. Majumdar
arxiv-2506-08128.description: Abstract Quantum networks offer a compelling platform for probing nonlocal correlations beyond the Bell scenario. While network nonlocality has been well studied in discrete-variable (DV) systems, its exploration in continuous-variable (CV) systems remains limited. In this work, we study the bilocal scenario, the simplest quantum network, in a CV framework using pseudospin measurements.

arxiv-2507-06866.title: A Bayesian catalog of 100 high-significance voids in the Local Universe
arxiv-2507-06866.creator: R. Malandrino ,, G. Lavaux, B. D. Wandelt, S. McAlpine, J. Jasche
arxiv-2507-06866.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by R. Malandrino ,, G. Lavaux, B. D. Wandelt, S. McAlpine, J. Jasche. While cosmic voids are now recognized as a valuable cosmological probe, identifying them in a galaxy catalog is challenging for multiple reasons: observational effects such as holes in the mask or magnitude selection hinder the detection process; galaxies are biased tracers of the underlying dark matter distribution; and it is non-trivial to estimate the detection significance and parameter uncertainties for individual voids.

arxiv-2507-14872.title: Numerical Conformal Mapping
arxiv-2507-14872.creator: Lloyd N. Trefethen
arxiv-2507-14872.description: Abstract Conformal mapping may be the best-known topic in complex analysis. Any simply connected nonempty domain \Omega in the complex plane {\mathbb{C}} (assuming \Omega\neq{\mathbb{C}} ) can be mapped bijectively to the unit disk by an analytic function with nonvanishing derivative, as in Figure 1.

pmc-12458821.title: The clinical application of shared decision-making in emergency surgery: a scoping review protocol
pmc-12458821.creator: Carly Nichola Bisset, Celia Keane, Tracey McKee, Rachel John-Charles, Cameron Iain Wells, Susan Joan Moug
pmc-12458821.description: AbstractIntroductionShared decision-making (SDM) between clinicians and patients is considered ‘best practice’. There is limited evidence regarding SDM in surgery, particularly in the emergency setting. Emergency SDM may be particularly challenging due to: time pressures, the patient’s underlying condition and the nature of the patient-surgeon interaction.

pmc-12596631.title: Effect of coagulants on physiochemical properties, texture, color and microstructure characterization of cow milk cheese
pmc-12596631.creator: Azra Akbar, Muhammad Ikram Nabeel, Amna Jabbar Siddiqui, Syed Ghulam Musharraf
pmc-12596631.description: Cheese is a globally significant dairy product, with production increasing due to high consumer demand. As a nutrient-rich food, it provides essential nutrients for human health. However, low cheese yield remains a major economic challenge for cheesemakers. This study examines the effects of different rennet /coagulants calf, pig, microbial, and acetic acid on the physicochemical properties of cow milk cheese.

pmc-12626295.title: Educational attainment and self-reported environmental exposures of pregnant women living in Nairobi, Kenya
pmc-12626295.creator: Christopher Zuidema, Priscillah Wanini Edemba, Anne M. Riederer, Vincent K. Kipter, Allison R. Sherris, Lewis Olweywe, Judith Adhiambo, Brendah Isavwa, Erica A. Wetzler, Barbra A. Richardson, John Kinuthia, Michael J. Gatari, Elizabeth Maleche-Obimbo, Edmund Seto, Catherine J. Karr, Sarah Benki-Nuge
pmc-12626295.description: Environmental exposures experienced by pregnant women living in cities of low- and middle-income countries are poorly described. We collected information on housing characteristics, household and ambient air pollution, and work-related exposures through questionnaires in a cohort of 400 pregnant women in Nairobi, Kenya and examined exposures in relation to educational attainment, a proxy for socioeconomic status.

pmc-12688255.title: Personalized risk prediction of lateral lymph node metastasis in male papillary thyroid cancer: a sex-specific model leveraging central lymph node ratio
pmc-12688255.creator: Xue Zhang, Yuan Qin, Niuniu Hou, Yunjiao Zhang, Changjiao Yan, Xi Chen, Chutuo Liu, Chong Chen, Rui Ling
pmc-12688255.description: AimsNotable sex-based disparities exist in papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC), necessitating male-specific models for predicting lateral lymph node metastasis (LLNM) to guide treatment.MethodsWe developed and validated two nomograms, based on central lymph node ratio (LNR) and preoperative ultrasound (US), respectively, using data from 433 male PTC patients who underwent total thyroidectomy (TT) with central and lateral neck lymph node dissection.

pmc-13351901.title: Remarkable response to personalized combination immunotherapy of nivolumab plus ipilimumab in an 84-year-old patient with locally advanced squamous cell carcinoma: a case report
pmc-13351901.creator: Ruifeng Li, Jiawei Chen, Zijian Li, Dixuan Zhang, Shuben Li
pmc-13351901.description: BackgroundThe efficacy of nivolumab plus ipilimumab (NIVO + IPI) combination therapy has been established for advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC). However, in elderly patients, the standard-dose regimens of NIVO + IPI exhibit high risk of immune-related adverse events (irAEs) and concerns over relapse due to treatment discontinuation.

pmc-13382659.title: Numerical Investigation of Thermally Induced Fracturing via Endothermic Thermal Shock in Ultratight High-Temperature Gas Reservoirs
pmc-13382659.creator: Fahad Khan, Zeeshan Tariq, Mohamed Mahmoud, Arshad Raza, Murtadha J. AlTammar, Abdulazeez Abdulraheem
pmc-13382659.description: Hydraulic fracturing operation in ultratight gas reservoirs under high temperature has often proved inadequate due to large fluid requirements, limited fracture propagation, and rapid production decline. This study proposes and evaluates a novel cooling-driven stimulation technique in which an externally heated rock is subjected to rapid thermal shock through the injection of endothermic chemicals.

pmc-13391260.title: Unique expression pattern of circulating exosomal miRNA correlates with CNS pathology
pmc-13391260.creator: Krzysztof Selmaj, Magda Tinsley, Jerome Badaut, Marcin P. Mycko
pmc-13391260.description: Background and objectivesTo investigate the total circulating exosome transcriptome in animal models of two different CNS pathologic conditions, autoimmune demyelination and traumatic brain injury (TBI).MethodsNext generation sequencing (NGS) was used to define the global RNA profile of blood exosomes in the MOG-induced EAE model of autoimmune demyelination and TBI mice model.

pmc-13574335.title: Applications of artificial intelligence in chronic kidney disease: a systematic review
pmc-13574335.creator: Jalila Andréa Sampaio Bittencourt, Aline Santana Figueredo, Naruna Aritana Costa Melo, Cindy Lima Pereira, Yuri Armin Crispim de Moraes, Margareth Santos Costa Penha, Darah de Lourdes Costa Lindoso Marques, Evelyn Feitosa Rodrigues, Arthur André Castro da Costa, Allan Kardec Duailibe Barros
pmc-13574335.description: OBJECTIVE To identify the applications of artificial intelligence in the early diagnosis, prediction and management of chronic kidney disease, highlighting the algorithms used, clinical outcomes, and impacts on nephrology practice.METHODS In this systematic review, PubMed and Scopus databases were searched without year or language restrictions, including studies published between 2019 and 2025.

pmc-13581911.title: Factors associated with poor cardiometabolic control in patients with type 2 diabetes: a Lasso-Firth penalized regression analysis
pmc-13581911.creator: Wei Yang, Da-shuai Xie, Chao Song, Jing Li, Fei-fei Wu, Xiao Zhang, Le Ma, Yao-jun Ning, Jian-feng Wang, Rong-hong Li, Li-hong Hao, Pei Gu, Ping Shi, Xiao-jing Wang, Qin Zhang
pmc-13581911.description: ObjectiveTo assess cardiometabolic control among patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) in Shanxi Province and identify variables associated with poor cardiometabolic control.MethodsData on demographic characteristics, medical history, Knowledge–Attitude–Practice (KAP) questionnaire scores, and clinical measurements of blood pressure, glucose, and lipid levels were collected from seven hospitals in Shanxi Province between June 2024 and June 2025.

uslaw-usc-t7-s75.title: 7 U.S.C. § 75 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t7-s75.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s75.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 3 (Grain Standards). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. When used in this chapter, except where the context requires otherwise— (a) the term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Agriculture of the United States or delegates of the Secretary; (b) the term “Department of Agriculture” means the United States Department of Agriculture; (c) the term “person” means.
